composition_notes: Two hands exchange short sixteenth-note bursts before the upper current becomes continuous.
Alternating sixteenth-note sparks retain their leaping character; octave choices join successive gestures and the final burst reaches a connected leading-note cadence.
The score records each added suspension and scalar connection explicitly for teaching.
The free preludes are reviewed for note integrity, spelling, harmonic context and the listed voice-leading changes; they are not advertised as strict-species exercises.
